summary: Iteration 3 — Validated the two NEW admin buttons on Kanban (Importer EDOF + Vider) end-to-end on the backend (35/35 pytest PASS: 9 new + 26 regression). Auto-seed of the 3 required formateurs (NEO FORMATION / HIGH SKILLS / VIRGINIA DERFEUIL) verified via GET /api/formateurs. Full EDOF import path verified: parses CSV with French headers (Nom;Prénom;Date de naissance;Adresse;Email;Téléphone;Intitulé de la formation;Date de début;Date de fin), auto-maps the 9 columns, creates dossiers with status=devis_attente, parses DD/MM/YYYY dates to ISO, attaches default_formateur_id, applies default_financeur and default_formation, returns {created,total_rows,skipped[],mapping_detected,columns}. Validation errors covered: invalid formateur (400), file > 15 MB (400 'Fichier trop volumineux'), missing Nom/Prénom columns (400), rows without nom or prénom -> skipped[]. xlsx import works (openpyxl). DELETE /api/dossiers-admin/clear validated for scope=all/active/closed (preserves the correct subset). All admin endpoints require auth (401). Frontend code-inspection: KanbanDashboard exposes the 3 buttons (open-edof-import, open-clear-dossiers, goto-onboarding); EdofImportDialog has all data-testids (edof-import-dialog, edof-dropzone, edof-file-input, edof-default-financeur/formation/formateur, edof-import-submit, edof-import-result, edof-result-close) and submit is disabled until a file is selected; ClearDossiersDialog has scope-all/scope-active/scope-closed radios, clear-confirm-input, clear-submit disabled until exactly 'SUPPRIMER' is typed. E2E browser automation login intermittently flaky (the first run succeeded and redirected to /dashboard, subsequent runs the form-submit click didn't trigger POST /api/auth/login — Playwright synthetic event timing). Backend curl evidence (35/35 pytest) plus main-agent's manual confirmation cover the EDOF + Clear flows.

minor.issue: scope query string is permissive: any value other than 'active'/'closed' falls back to 'all'. Consider validating with Literal['all','active','closed'] and returning 422 on bad input.
default_financeur is silently coerced to 'CPF' when not in OPCO/CPF/Privé. Either validate (422) or document. Same for default_formation: not constrained.

integration_issues.issue: In Playwright, the 'Se connecter' button click intermittently does not trigger POST /api/auth/login (no network request fired). The first attempt of the session succeeded (reached /dashboard); subsequent attempts get stuck on /login. May be a React form-submit / synthetic event handling quirk — not reproducible manually per main agent.

issues: The drop-zone is implemented as a <label> wrapping a hidden <input type=file>. Drag-and-drop is NOT supported (only click-to-select). The UI hint 'Cliquez pour sélectionner un fichier' is correct so this is acceptable, but consider adding drop handlers if drag-and-drop is intended.

action_items: (Optional, hardening) Constrain DELETE /api/dossiers-admin/clear `scope` to Literal['all','active','closed'] for clearer 422 errors on typo.
(Optional, hardening) Validate default_financeur ∈ {OPCO,CPF,Privé} and reject otherwise instead of silent CPF fallback in import-edof.
(Optional, UX) Make EDOF drop-zone actually accept drag-and-drop or rephrase the label to 'Cliquer pour parcourir' to avoid raising expectations.
(Pre-existing from iteration 2) Replace native date input on Onboarding with shadcn Calendar.

Main agent: please self-verify the 3 Kanban frontend E2E steps in browser (login → click Importer EDOF → upload CSV → see 3 cards; click Vider → SUPPRIMER → Kanban empty). The dialogs and data-testids are all wired correctly per code inspection.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.py: 3 required formateurs (NEO/HIGH/VIRGINIA) added idempotently via find_one + insert_one — correct, no duplication on restart. Verified via /api/formateurs.

routes/dossiers.py L335-418 (import-edof): correctly reads multipart, enforces 15 MB cap BEFORE parsing, validates default_formateur_id exists, and uses parse_date_fr for the 3 date columns. status=devis_attente set explicitly. Notes field traces 'Importé depuis EDOF · {filename}' — good audit trail.
routes/dossiers.py L288-320 (clear): correctly deletes both DB documents AND filesystem files. Uses {'status': {'$ne':'regle'}} for active and {'status':'regle'} for closed. Returns deletion counts.

import_edof.py auto_map: EXCLUDE rules for 'nom' include ['prenom','organisme','formation','session'] which correctly prevents the 'Prénom' column being captured as 'nom'. Same protection for 'formation' avoiding 'Date de début/fin'. Tested with 3-row CSV: all 9 mapped correctly.
EdofImportDialog.jsx: submit disabled when !file — verified. Result panel shows mapping and skipped rows — implementation matches spec.
ClearDossiersDialog.jsx: submit disabled unless confirmText === 'SUPPRIMER' exactly (case-sensitive, no trim) — tested 'WRONG' stays disabled; only 'SUPPRIMER' enables.
KanbanDashboard.jsx L177-191: three buttons rendered with correct data-testid and ordering (EDOF gray → Vider red → Nouveau stagiaire navy).

success_rate.frontend: Code-inspection only; live E2E blocked by Playwright login flakiness — see integration_issues.

seed_data_creation: Tests create temp CSV in-memory (no fixtures left in DB). Each test_clear_scopes and test_rows_without_nom_or_prenom_skipped calls DELETE /api/dossiers-admin/clear?scope=all at start AND end — DB is left empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 35 backend tests live under /app/backend/tests/. Run them with: pytest backend/tests/ -v. The NEW endpoints DELETE /api/dossiers-admin/clear and POST /api/dossiers-admin/import-edof are fully covered. Auto-seeded formateurs ids can be retrieved with GET /api/formateurs filter prenom in (NEO,HIGH,VIRGINIA). Playwright login is intermittent — prefer doing API-driven session setup (POST /api/auth/login to get cookies) and then page.context.add_cookies(...) before goto. Frontend selectors confirmed: open-edof-import, open-clear-dossiers, edof-import-dialog, edof-file-input, edof-default-{financeur,formation,formateur}, edof-import-submit, edof-import-result, edof-result-close, clear-dialog, scope-{all,active,closed}, clear-confirm-input, clear-submit.
rca of the issue: No product bug. Two minor hardening suggestions on backend input validation (clear scope literal + financeur literal). Frontend login flakiness is automation-side; main agent confirmed manual flow works.
